title: crate
text: rfp = tool plumbing. crate = declarative schemas + canonical data ops across NGE domains. rfp owns QGIS / Mergin / GPKG / GDAL / photo-file ops — gets field data canonical-shaped GPKG file staging area, stops. crate owns schemas, dictionary, QC rules, normalization, dedup, cross-reference, canonical PostGIS load, export contracts, lookup tables, lineage. Applies domains, just field forms (lab returns, benthic, historical pre-Mergin data also flow crate). fpr stays fish-passage domain compute called crt_normalize() / crt_validate() dispatch. Dependency direction: rfp → crate ← fpr ← link/fresh ← reporting. cycles. Concretely: rfp_form_wrangle/validate/export/db_load (rfp #30, #33, #34, #35) move crt_normalize/validate/export/load. rfp keeps _source_*, _mergin_*, _qgs_*, _project_*, _form_create, _form_backup, _gpx_import, _photo_*. Form templates: schema source--truth lives crate; rfp’s QML overlays decorate schema QGIS rendering.

title: Canonical Schema and Data Governance for New Graph Environment
text: Three pieces wire together runtime call crt_ingest("bcfp", "user_habitat_classification", path): Registry (inst/extdata/crate_registry.csv) — CSV mapping (source, file_name) pair handler function name schema YAML path. crate looks “know file?” . Schema YAML (inst/extdata/schemas/bcfp/user_habitat_classification.yaml) — declares canonical column shape known upstream variant (column-name set + normalize-function id). crate reads file path, matches actual columns variant’s declared columns; first set-equal match wins. Handler (R/internal_bcfp_user_habitat_classification.R) — one function per (source, file_name). Dispatches matched variant id runs right normalizer: 2026-04-26-wide → identity passthrough (already canonical) pre-2026-04-26-long → pivot long rows wide canonical, mapping habitat_ind text values integer indicators handler made type change transparent example. wide canonical declares spawning rearing integer columns; long upstream habitat_ind text ("t"/"f"). pivot function text→integer conversion step long→wide reshape — callers never see either intermediate form.

what: Caveat: variant matching is column-names only
title: Canonical Schema and Data Governance for New Graph Environment
text: crt_ingest() matches input upstream variants exact column-name set equality. validate column types. upstream later ships column names different types, handler receive misshapen data without erroring variant-match step. Type-aware variant matching (declaring cols: [{name, type}] validating ) planned v0.1.x improvement.
